title: Linear - Fast, keyboard-driven issue tracker built for engineering teams
clean_text: Linear is a fast, minimal, opinionated project management tool built specifically for software teams, combining issue tracking, sprint cycles, roadmapping, and AI-assisted triage in a keyboard-driven interface optimized for speed. It targets engineering-led companies that prioritize speed and craft over extensive customization, with adoption from companies such as Vercel, Ramp, and Mercury, and is especially popular with startups and engineering-focused teams. Linear explicitly positions itself as not the right choice for non-technical teams in marketing, sales, or HR that need general-purpose project management.

meta.target: software engineering teams and engineering-led startups
